about:
# Ten Minute Goblin

Gold for a player with little auction-house time. Claude makes the calls, you carry them out.

`/goblin` or the **Goblin** button on the auction house. Needs Auctionator.

## Pages

- **Today**: the call sheet. "Buy 20 · ≤ 9s", "Post 12 · 14s", "Visit Kazan". Done, Later, Pass per row.
  A post or hold shows only while you hold the item. Below it the live lists: Hold, Post, Vendor,
  Deals, Vendor flips, Craft, Visit.
- **Deals**: cheap now against usual, steady supply, sells. One click opens the Auctionator search.
- **Vendor**: auctions below vendor price; vendors worth a trip.
- **Ledger**: your recipes, every profession: Cost, Profit, Make / Wait / Skip.
- **Money**: in, out, net by day; calls, flips, posts; All or one character.
- **Today's calls** (on Today): open, done, later, passed, expired; Show again; the last 7 days.

Mode slider on Today: **Adventure** (on your path), **Detours**, **Goblin** (everything).

## Everywhere

- Item tooltip: Usual, Today, **Post / Hold / Vendor**, Cook / Smelt, Sells Fast / Slow / ?.
- Merchants: a coin and the gain on items worth reselling.
- Login briefing: "6 calls · ~12 min · +3g" and up to three notes.
- Call tracker: the open calls on screen, quest-tracker style; drag to move, fold to one line,
  click to open Today. Hidden in combat and when there is nothing to do.
- `/goblin tracker`, `/goblin briefing`, `/goblin tooltip` turn each off and on.
- Key bindings (AddOns): Goblin window, Mode up / down (bumpers), Call tracker.

## Data

Prices come from Auctionator (always), the hourly `TenMinuteGoblinData` addon when fresher,
and TSM when present. The ages show as "Calls 3h · Prices 1h". No scan: "Scan first".

The addon records what you hold, sell, post and spend, for the analyser.
Fields: [docs/CONTRACT.md](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-TenMinuteGoblin/blob/master/docs/CONTRACT.md). Reasoning: [docs/DESIGN.md](https://github.com/Mimezu/forever-TenMinuteGoblin/blob/master/docs/DESIGN.md).

Never automates buying, posting or cancelling.

## Tests

```
lua5.1 tests\test_logic.lua .
lua5.1 tests\test_money.lua .
lua5.1 tests\test_prices.lua .
```

releases.notes:
**Download `TenMinuteGoblin-0.5.3.zip` below** (not "Source code").

1. Close the game.
2. Unzip into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`.
3. Start the game, type `/goblin`.

## First release

- Gold for little auction-house time: a call sheet of what to buy, post, hold and where to sell.
- Deals, vendor flips, crafts, visits. Needs Auctionator.
